chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang’s Shocking Discovery: Hong Zhong Is a Heart-Element! | Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 424
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang returns to the capital carrying his own headless corpse, but what awaits him at the Supervisory Heavenly Office—a severed head, an incense shrine, and a revelation that flips everything he knew about the Zuowandao.
og_title: What If Your Enemy Was Also a Living Alchemical Ingredient? | DGYX Ch. 424
og_description: Li Huowang brings his own future corpse home, only to find a square-jawed head on a shrine and learn that Hong Zhong might be a Heart-Element.
twitter_title: The moment your enemy’s head becomes evidence that they’re the same species as *you* | DGYX Ch. 424
twitter_description: Hong Zhong’s head on a shrine, incense burning, and a Heart-Element twist that rewrites everything.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare human constitution in the Dao-Twisted World that makes its bearer a highly valuable raw material for alchemy and ritual—a living, thinking ingredient that other cultivators would kill to refine.
In xianxia cultivation, a condensed life-force entity formed at a high realm; possessing more than one is a mark of heretical sects like the Luo Sect, often with grotesque physical manifestations.
A heretical branch of cultivation known for taboo bodily modifications and usurping orthodox techniques; having two protruding Nascent Souls is a signature sign.
A government-sponsored institution that polices supernatural threats in the Dao-Twisted World; its agents are feared and its loyalties are ambiguous.
A Zuowandao trickster whose square-jawed face is a signature physical trait; the revelation that he may be a Heart-Element has massive implications for the plot.
